question.title: An invariant greatest common divisor
question.statement: Prove that gcd(n, n + 10) = gcd(n, 10) for every positive integer n.
question.solution: If d divides both n and n+10, it divides their difference 10; hence d is a common divisor of n and 10. Conversely, if d divides n and 10, it divides n+10. The sets of positive common divisors coincide, so their greatest members coincide.

rubric.description: Prove every common divisor of n and n+k divides k.
Prove the converse inclusion of common divisors.
Conclude equality of the greatest positive common divisors.
